Name: Whimsical Clumps and Nodes
Author: aerinanxiety
Description:
[center][size=4][b][u]NO generated art. Only code.[/u][/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Sweet Food Nodes has always been a must-have mod for me. Though the original version stopped working, I decided to take a peek at the code and see if I could fix it. [/color][color=#d4d4d8]I decided to repackage all of Monster Clumps and Treasures of the Sea along with Sweet Food Nodes into a neat little pack for myself. I've completely reworked how spawn rates work, along with added the ability to customize each node's base spawn rate and enable/disable spawns node-by-node. Recently added depth scaling, so the deeper you go the more likely it is you'll find better loot.[/color][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=3][color=#d4d4d8][size=3]Over time I just kind of thought of silly/neat ideas for some new nodes and clumps myself so I've thrown those in here as well, also toggleable. All art for these is pulled from Stardew itself and edited together/drawn a bit differently by myself (I'm no artist, be warned!). I'll probably keep adding some here and there. Like the Feesh Clump, which drops a smattering of fish and other slightly slimier things. These are compatible with fish added by the following: More New Fish, Aquatic Sea Fish, and Fish Fever. Turn these off and on in the config, it'll autodetect them by default. There's no legendary fish included. [/size][/color]

[/size][b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b][/center]
[center]Download the .rar, unzip into your mods folder.[/center]
[center][/center]
